text:
incident-bot: PD alert fired: PD-98321 — autoscaler unable to keep up; queued requests > 45k for inference-cell-prod (link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-98321)
pagerduty: Incident triggered: autoscaler/high-queue-backlog — paging eng-oncall rotation
omar: ack — I'm on it. grabbing metrics now.
jen: see the spike on prefix-queue, looks like KV warmup is not happening, p95 latency for request enqueue is ~9s. loading graphs: https://grafana.redwood/uid/queue/overview
lee: confirmed. node provisioning events show failed allocations from cloud provider between 02:12-02:16 UTC. a bunch of spot preempts.
maria: getting 503s from frontend logs: several pods returning 503 on highest percentiles;  error rate ~1.8% and counting.
omar: autoscaler logs show repeated "scale decision suppressed: cooldown or rate-limit" around 02:14. posting snippet: ```2026-03-15T02:14:12Z INFO scale_decision suppressed reason=api_quota_limit current_replicas=120 desired=160```
jen: hmm. the cluster api quota is at 1000/sec but we hit a 429 backoff on the controller. maybe cloud api throttle.
alex: I'm seeing dispatcher backlog growth: queue depth per-shard rising linearly — KV cache miss rate jumped to 78% after a rolling restart earlier today.
ops-rotation: tagging @omar @jen — do we want to manual-scale a hot pool while we investigate?
omar: yes. proposal: manual bump +40 to the inference compute pool, set autoscaler min=160 -> 200, and add temporary on-call override TTL 1h.
lee: I'll run the nodegroup scale now: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed set-size ig-inference-prod --size=200` — doing dry-run then execute.
maria: routing mitigation: we can shift 20% of traffic to region-b replicas to relieve cell A. have to be careful with stateful prefix cache though.
jen: do NOT shift traffic yet until KV warmup handles prefixes — otherwise we'll have duplicate cold misses. alternative: reduce concurrency per-instance to speed up enqueue throughput. set env VAR `MAX_CONCURRENCY=8` on inference pods.
omar: executing manual scale + setting min replicas. leave autoscaler enabled after change. updating incident timeline.
incident-bot: manual scale initiated by lee — set-size request accepted (operation op-43a).
lee: scale ops finished. new instance count 200. nodes are joining, kubelet reports Ready for 160 nodes so far.
alex: after nodes join, queue depth flattened but p95 latency still elevated ~1.9s for token generation — but enqueue backlog dropped 80% in last 6m.
maria: customer impact note: proportional 503s reduced from 1.8% -> 0.4% after scale, some customers still seeing intermittent slow responses on long-context requests.
jen: root cause hypothesis: a combination of cloud API throttling + a KV warmup regression in rollout earlier today that increased miss rate; autoscaler suppressed by cooldown logic and rate limits so it couldn't respond fast enough.
sre-bot: runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/autoscaler-queue-backlog — steps taken: manual-scale, traffic-shift plan put on hold, concurrency under-provision adjusted.
omar: next steps: 1) follow up with cloud provider on API throttle; 2) roll back the KV warmup PR from earlier (repro on staging); 3) adjust autoscaler cooldown and rate-limit thresholds; 4) schedule postmortem.
ops-rotation: adding oncall-backup to PD rotation for next 30m while we monitor. @alex please keep an eye on error-rate dashboards.
alex: monitoring logs, will call if error-rate crosses 1%.
jen: tagging product-ops and support: brief customer impact summary: "Short-lived degradation affecting a subset of long-context inference requests (peak 1.8% 503s). Mitigation: manual capacity added; service restored to expected levels for most traffic. Follow-up PM/SE outreach recommended for affected customers."
maria: collecting a list of impacted customer IDs and times — pushing to incident ticket PD-98321.
omar: ack. putting a temporary embargo on non-essential deploys to inference cell until we finish rollback test.
incident-bot: PD-98321 acknowledged by omar. Escalation cleared.
lee: last check — all nodes Ready, queue depth stable, tail APM traces show normal completion counts. I'll keep the manual scale for 30m then let autoscaler re-evaluate.
sre-bot: note for postmortem: include autoscaler rate-limit thresholds, cloud API error patterns, and the KV warmup change set.
alex: monitoring green for 12m, error-rate at 0.25%.
omar: marking incident as mitigated in thread. will schedule postmortem and circulate notes. thanks all. :thumbsup:
